verdict: Best Buy's revenue rose 4% to $9.8B as comparable sales grew 4.1% — computing, home theater and even AI glasses and trading cards — and net income jumped 69% to $315M against a charge-hit quarter last year.

segments.name: Domestic
segments.note: U.S. stores and bestbuy.com — comparable sales rose 4.5%, led by computing and home theater, plus emerging categories like AI glasses and trading cards.

segments.name: International
segments.note: Canada and Mexico — comparable sales fell 1.8% and currency was a headwind.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Store staff, rent and technology. As reported, SG&A was $1,923M, reduced by a $6M restructuring credit; last year's quarter carried $114M of restructuring charges.

otherDetail: Investment income of $20M, less $11M of interest expense.

takeaways.title: Comparable sales grew 4.1%
takeaways.text: Best Buy's best growth in years: computing and home theater led, with new categories (AI glasses, trading cards) adding novelty demand.

takeaways.title: Profit jumped to $315M
takeaways.text: The comparison is flattering — last year's quarter absorbed $114M of restructuring charges — but gross margin also improved to 23.9% on better product margins.

takeaways.title: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: Best Buy lifted its FY27 outlook: comparable sales of +1.9% to +3.0% and adjusted EPS of $6.70–$6.90.

footerNote: Best Buy's fiscal year ends in late January, so this is Q2 of fiscal 2027. Tax is shown at $115M (the reported expense of $116M reflects unrounded figures) so the flow reconciles exactly to reported net earnings of $315M.
